title: The Pattern Cottage
tagline: Squares, circles, and the story that keeps repeating
description: The brothers Grimm walked the villages writing stories that repeat like choruses. A shapes and patterns adventure where borders repeat, tables sort, and close reading shows the want, the block, and the choice.
worldPrompt: An original, folkloric adventure drawn from Grimms' Fairy Tales (Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm 1812-1857, public domain). The learner walks between villages with the collecting brothers and the folk who tell the tales: miller, woodcutter, tailor. Each chapter gates the maths or reading unit: naming 2D shapes by sides, equal shares and halves, sorting by a rule, repeating patterns, and close reading want block choice. Visuals are craft: painted borders, wooden tables, paper and ink. No contemporary culture. Loot is village-made things: loaf, painted tile, sorting tray, border brush.

characters.name: Jacob
characters.bio: The elder brother who listens longest. He teaches you to collect one tale cleanly before moving to the next.

characters.name: Wilhelm
characters.bio: The stylist who makes a collected tale readable. He checks that a shape pattern repeats without a break.

characters.name: The Miller
characters.bio: Knows loaves, halves, and fair cuts. He will only call two pieces halves if they are equal.

characters.name: The Woodcutter
characters.bio: Knows timber, corners, and whether a quadrilateral has square corners.

chapters.title: The Four Shapes on the Door
chapters.hook: Circle, triangle, square, rectangle. Count sides, then corners, and name them.

chapters.title: The Fair Loaf
chapters.hook: Two hungry children, one loaf. Equal shares or no halves at all.

chapters.title: The Sorting Table
chapters.hook: One rule at a time, each thing in the group its rule names.

chapters.title: The Border and the Tale
chapters.hook: The gate repeats circle, square. The story repeats danger, helper, test, reward.

loot.name: Miller's Loaf
loot.description: A round loaf scored into quarters. Shows equal shares or no halves. Chapter 2, the fair cut.

loot.name: Painted Tile
loot.description: One tile from the cottage door: a shape you can count by sides. Chapter 1, the four shapes.

loot.name: Sorting Tray
loot.description: The wooden tray the villages use. One rule at a time, each shape where it belongs. Chapter 3, the sorting house.

loot.name: Border Brush
loot.description: The brush that paints the repeating border without a break. Chapter 4, the cottage gate.

loot.name: Collector's Quill
loot.description: Wilhelm's quill when want, block, and choice are named together and the pattern named too. Legendary close reading clear.
